Title: Resource GUID changes for Event Hubs Dedicated Capacity Unit

Body.Content:
On June 1, 2019, the meter IDs (also known as resource GUIDs) for Azure Event Hubs Dedicated will change. The Event Hubs Dedicated Capacity Unit global meter ID (804d2883-5e18-44c5-8882-6c72b306200a) will break out into regional meters.
